scope: Native maximum-history radome skin damage, incomplete physical fracture model; fresh coupled10ms tests. No ORTHENERG transfer or historical fit.

nose.shape: ellipsoid section r(x)/r(root)=sqrt(1-(1-x/root)^2), joined to inherited X=2m ring; own hypothesis
nose.root_joint: common nodes, ideal perfect bond, no fastener failure
nose.metal_frames_and_stringers_inside_radome: remove in composite cases; retain in geometry-only metal control
nose.mass_policy: derive physical mass change; no top-up to old/historical mass, no hidden stiffness
nose.fine_mesh: subdivide all radome edges except root boundary, exact piecewise-flat geometry; conforming 3-triangle root transitions, no hanging node

sandwich.material_law: LAW25 Iform0, elastic by very high internal yield/failure caps; diagnostic real reference strengths separate

face.reference: Hexcel HexPly913,7781GL/R913, PDF page4: rho1.83g/cc,E1 tension22GPa; E2,nu and G values own balanced-woven approximations, no assignment to actual767

core.reference: HexWeb HRH10-3.2-48,PDF page4: transverse E138MPa,G_L41MPa,G_W24MPa; in-plane E1/E2,G12 and nu own placeholders; E33 unused in plane-stress shell

contact.radome_self_only: TYPE7, same secondary/main radome; constant gap actual total sandwich thickness, friction0,normal viscosity1e-20

units.native: g mm ms MPa N Nmm

engine.reference_family: CF6-80A/A2, not a historical aircraft engine identification
engine.mass_scope: EASA p19 note1 includes basic accessories and listed optional equipment/sensors
engine.envelope_scope: EASA p9 bare engine overall dimensions; they do not identify nacelle contours, structural radii or thicknesses
engine.location_scope: Boeing airport-planning geometry inherited; vertical offset own hypothesis
engine.nacelle_material: inherited aluminum reference LAW2/1, not measured nacelle material
engine.case_and_mount_material: inherited generic steel reference LAW2/3, not actual engine alloy identification
engine.mass_partition: dry shell mass subtracted from3980.7; nacelle+new joints subtracted from519.3; nonnegative residual distributed in32 existing engine ADMAS points; old pylon mass unchanged
engine.RBE3_scope: engine inertia supported only by new engine shell nodes; no direct nearest-wing shortcut

local_control_scope: Whole coupled airframe retained; facade translated by engine front x, only new engine shell secondary nodes contact it. Nose/wing contact intentionally excluded; this is not a full flight-through-facade simulation.

energy_contract_for_future_fracture.candidate: traction-opening law with maximum-opening history and explicit stored/dissipated energy; not transferred to Engine or whole airplane

mesh_refinement: Each engine triangle split into four coplanar triangles using shared edge midpoints. Original joint anchors and RBE3 hosts unchanged. No smoothing, no material/thickness/force adjustment.

output_contract.damage: DAMA/ALL native retained; all native states0.1ms retained, geometry review0.5ms
output_contract.observer: native first record only for final energy/time; observer contacts andREAC excluded

declared_mechanism_controls.TYPE7_Istf5: main/secondary stiffness in series, documented alternative
declared_mechanism_controls.Stfac0.1: numerical penalty sensitivity only, not material softness identification
declared_mechanism_controls.RBE3_Iform3: engine32 constraints penalty only, documented alternative; other336 unchanged
declared_mechanism_controls.material_failure: disabled; no material or thickness changes
declared_mechanism_controls.stored_constraint_energy: all native global spring/IE/damping/contact terms retained; missing attribution must not be assumed zero

user_steering: 2026-10-08 direct request: if aircraft ready launch it into facade; advance beyond local controls. This changes A15 work route to a bounded exploratory whole-scene experiment, without changing any A11-A14 failures or qualifying the aircraft.

scene_changes.contacts: four exterior TYPE7 replaced by canonical TYPE25 nodes/surface, same nodal groups and fixed gap5mm
scene_changes.native_penalty: Stfac1, Istf4; no area weighting introduced or qualified on aircraft
scene_changes.facade: 31986 quadrilateral shells, only944 boundary nodes fixed; interior deformable, no fire/building interior

transfer_policy.Stfac1: inherited default and diagnostic candidate; no spatial/aircraft qualification inherited from 1D witness
transfer_policy.native_RKE: use global once only, part and independent reconstructions exploratory, never added to close budget

stages.execution: Both cases predeclared. Stop each on error, nonpositive step or600s cost cap; save incomplete attempts. No restarts beyond declared horizon. Numerical/material failures retained and reported, not an authorization barrier to this exploratory run.
stages.seconds: not requested as an hours-long job here; 10ms=0.01s, not first seconds

parent_status: Main A11 prototype executable; parallel joint adapter not dynamically ready and not integrated.

prior_failure_reused.why: A06 energy depends on size and repeated equal peaks accumulate damage; prior outputs used without rerun

damage.applies_to: radome face material4 only; core5 intact
damage.threshold_derivation: reference uniaxial strength/E; own balanced-woven simplification, not actual aircraft identification or multiaxial strength law
damage.directions: 11 and22 same thresholds; shear and33 unmodelled/disabled1e20
damage.transition_provenance: .2 matches documentation default ratio; .02 own one-decade sensitivity; neither calibrated to damage
damage.energy: No entered fracture energy. Work/dissipation checked, implied energy remains mesh-dependent and unqualified. Do not label this regularized physical tearing.
damage.element_deletion: not expected: intact8mm core and global thickness threshold1 retained

witness_acceptance.gate_role: mechanical implementation/history gate only; never physical fracture energy qualification
